notes: bis-ranker-integrity-16 lane, 2026-09-30 (fourteenth player sweep, casters.md and hybrids.md both flagged this independently): `vendor:15192` (Anachronos, the Silithus Bronze Dragonflight emissary) sells the Ahn'Qiraj War Effort reward line -- Signet Ring of the Bronze Dragonflight (234032) among them -- as a flat, ungated wowhead-sourced vendor buy: no `opens`, no reputation, no currency, nothing distinguishing it from an ordinary launch-day vendor. In the real game these are war-effort turn-in rewards Anachronos hands out only once the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj event is running, in the run-up to the AQ40/AQ20 raid opening -- the same event `curated/loot/forever-raid-phases.json` already gates `raid:ahnqiraj` on (no announced date yet, so `opens: "later"`), and the same one `sim/cmd/leveling-bis/data.go`'s own `raidLockedQuestOpens` hand list already gates for the war effort's QUEST-turn-in path (quest ids 8756/8789/8790, that file's own comment: 'Ahn'Qiraj War Effort reward'). Anachronos's own direct-vendor row bypassed that quest-only gate entirely, publishing the identical reward set as a walk-up purchase available from the moment a character reaches level 60 -- this project's own dates put that over a month before raids open at all (launch 4 November, first raid tier 9 December). Primary source checked: classic-db's `item_template.json` states no gold/ItemExtendedCost override for these ids at all (an ordinary vendor sale, unlike the vendor-11036 lane's own unresolvable-currency finding), and this build's own `loot.json` vendor row for 15192 confirms no `opens`/faction/currency gate was ever applied to it -- so the fix here is the same phase gate `raid:ahnqiraj` already carries, on the vendor that sells its own war-effort loot, not a currency or price fix. Kept in its own file rather than folded into forever-raid-phases.json: that file's own tests (`test_the_seven_generated_raids_are_all_patched_not_added`) pin its `replace` list to exactly the seven raid sources the loot generator emits, and a vendor id is not one of them.
